nlp.intro: This report shows how SchemeMatch processed your situation, extracted your details, understood the meaning and context through the 4-module NLP pipeline, and matched applicable government schemes.
nlp.extractedInfoDesc: Information extracted directly from the user's input text for government scheme eligibility.
nlp.dependentInfoDesc: Dependent details are separated from the primary user's attributes to prevent misattribution of education or age.
nlp.mod1Desc:
Identifies different forms of words and converts them into their common root forms.
This helps SchemeMatch recognize important keywords accurately from free-text input.
nlp.mod2Desc:
Analyzes sentence structure to identify relationships between words and entities.
This helps determine who has a particular attribute or information.
nlp.mod3Desc:
Converts extracted information into meaningful structured facts and concepts.
These semantic facts are used by the matching engine to identify relevant schemes.
nlp.mod4Desc:
Resolves references across sentences and prepares meaningful natural-language responses.
It explains the matched schemes and eligibility results clearly to the user.
nlp.mod4NoRef: No ambiguous references requiring resolution were identified in the provided text.
nlp.part3Desc: Identified matching government programmes from existing Scheme Matching Engine based on the extracted semantic facts.
nlp.officialVerifyNotice: Please verify detailed eligibility and required documents on the official government website before applying.
